svg.text: Straight DE9 cable: contacts1–9 connect to the same numbered contact. No guessed wire colours or mating-face orientation.
Signal path: Prime J37.3 → input J1.3 / J2.1 → output J1.1 / J2.3 → button; ground returns through DE9 contact5.
Prime5V reaches DE9 contact9 and the output regulator input. Output J2.1 is LOCAL_3V3, not Prime3V3: leave it UNUSED.
Output U1 TPS70933 output/load/enable behavior is not required by this dry-button example; source EN is unconnected.
Output J2.2 power, J2.4–9 unused signals, both Qwiic headers and all other field connections remain unused. No RS232 device.
Source DE9 rows2.77mm / separation2.84mm; Gadgeteer1.27mm. Depicted symbols use20mm / nonuniform spacing.
Keep electrical symbols distinct from source solder geometry. Fitted cable, voltage/rail budget and physical orientation remain OPEN.
P11 Prime art with checked P12 GF allocation only. Full-art audit and actual desktop/narrow page-viewer acceptance remain OPEN.
